items.title: Eaton Just Dropped 16% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysEaton stock fell 16% in the past month as AI-power stocks sold off, and GE Vernova and Vertiv fell too. The worst drop came after Meta raised its 2026 capex plans and its free cash flow turned negative.

items.title: Vistra Gains 5% as Talen Guides 2027 EBITDA Up 26% on “Strong PJM Fundamentals”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVistra gained 5% today after Talen Energy guided 2027 adjusted EBITDA about 26% higher on PJM demand. Constellation Energy rose on the same news, and GE Vernova and Vertiv rallied on their own.

items.title: Bloom Energy Gains 9% on California Resources’ 1 GW Fuel Cell Tie-Up and Barclays Upgrade
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy rose 9% on a plan with California Resources for 1 GW or more of fuel cell power and a Barclays upgrade. The deal gives Bloom a low-carbon pitch for California data centers, but it’s non-binding.

items.title: If I Could Only Buy 1 AI Power Stock for the Next Decade, It Wouldn't Be Bloom Energy or GE Vernova
items.summary: Bloom Energy is clean tech, while GE Vernova is a picks-and-shovels play, but neither one offers me this investment's 5.4% yield.

items.title: Vertiv Soars 6%, Eaton Up 7% as Bernstein Calls Election-Day Data Center Fears Overblown
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVertiv stock jumped 6% after Bernstein called the political risk to US data-center construction overstated. Bernstein expects developers to pay more for power as projects go ahead.

items.title: Bloom Energy Rallies 11% on Barclays Upgrade and California Resources Tie-Up; FuelCell Energy Gains 5%, GE Vernova Climbs 3%
items.summary: A Wall Street upgrade and a surprise California carbon-capture deal pulled Bloom Energy out of a brutal month-long slide, but the real question is whether surging customer deposits signal a genuine inflection or a cash trap waiting to spring.
